softwareInnerHero.title: Advanced Thermal Screening & Imaging Solutions
paragraphs: Busy entrances need screening that does not create a second queue. Thermal cameras read temperature without contact and can alert staff in real time. Units can stand alone or link to access control and barriers. We place and tune them for the flow of your lobby or gate.
softwareInnerHero.imageAlt: Contactless thermal screening at building entry

cardSections.subheading: Thermal screening and imaging only — temperature detection, alerts, and screening dashboards.

items.title: Contactless Thermal Screening
items.body: Rapid, non-contact temperature measurement at entry points without slowing people flow.

items.title: High-Accuracy Temperature Detection
items.body: Thermal cameras calibrated for reliable skin-temperature screening in high-traffic lobbies and checkpoints.

items.title: Threshold Alerts
items.body: Real-time notifications when a configured temperature threshold is exceeded so staff can respond immediately.

items.title: Dual-Spectrum Thermal Imaging
items.body: Pair thermal and visual views so operators can confirm a screening event without a separate CCTV project.

items.title: Screening Dashboards
items.body: See live screening status, alerts, and checkpoint activity from a thermal-management interface.

items.title: Multi-Entry Checkpoints
items.body: Deploy standalone or linked thermal scanners across one lobby or many facility entrances.

cardSections.subheading: Why invest in professional thermal imaging solutions

items.title: Non-Contact Health Screening
items.body: Rapid, accurate temperature measurements without physical contact for safe mass screening.

items.title: Industrial Maintenance
items.body: Identify hotspots and anomalies in electrical systems, HVAC components, and building envelopes before failures occur.

items.title: Building Diagnostics
items.body: Detect insulation gaps, moisture issues, and structural problems with thermal imaging technology.

items.title: Energy Efficiency
items.body: Find heat loss areas and optimize energy consumption through targeted insulation improvements.

items.title: Certified Technicians
items.body: Our team is trained and certified by FLIR, FLUKE, and other leading thermal imaging manufacturers.

items.title: Turnkey Solutions
items.body: We handle everything from consultation to installation, calibration, and maintenance.

items.title: Priority Support
items.body: Comprehensive after-sales service with emergency response and regular calibration checks.

items.title: Regular Updates
items.body: Stay current with firmware updates and new feature enhancements for maximum performance.
